items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: But I played with Andrew that didn't burn, you know, when he was just high.

ctx.x: WDSU I think. Could have been WSMB.

We got Earl you see Earl Foster. Earl and Andrew Anderson's cousin you know. Oh yeah. I certainly would like to hear a record of Buddy Petit. Me too. Buddy must have made a record of somebody. You know what I'm saying sir? Cause him and Louis Armstrong was Buddy you know. And you too. Buddy was like that.
But, but Louie never gives Buddy credit.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Anderson, he used to work with us too. Andrew Anderson.

ctx.x: So we went over there, the brothers looked at us, you know. He was playing music. Punch and, uh, Brother Petit, they were his buddies, you know. And you know, when we meet on the valley, that's what they call it sometimes, by advertising, we buck against one another. And so they say, Kid Punch over here. And the man got scared, you know. He said, he kept me looking at us, and he said, uh, he said, now it's the same band here, Andrew. I said, they playing out there, but we got a better band this time. He said,…
